sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the four aspects of divine service correspond to the four worlds of Atzilus, Beriah, Yetzirah, and Asiyah, with the level of self-nullification in each reflecting the nature of that world.

translations.translation: And this is that the four aforementioned matters in the service of man are analogous to the four worlds of ABY"A,
for the self-nullification in the animal soul and in the intellectual soul,
where the self-nullification is something additional to their existence,
is in the manner of the self-nullification of Asiyah and Yetzirah.
[And to add,
that the fact that a courtyard requires guarding is because Asiyah and Yetzirah are [real] existence,
and therefore the things that descended from them require guarding.
And the matter of "your courtyards" is in the plural,
for the service that stems from the world of Asiyah,
its essence is action in actual deed,
for which the guarding by means of partitions—an uncovered courtyard—suffices,
and the service that stems from Yetzirah, its essence is the emotions,
for which the guarding of a roof—a covered courtyard—is needed].
And the intellect and emotions of the Elokis soul that are clothed in the animal soul,
where the self-nullification within them is not something additional to their existence but is analogous to the nullification of the yesh—this is in the manner of the self-nullification of Beriah,
and the self-nullification of the Elokis soul itself
(including also the self-nullification of the level of the soul that is clothed in the animal soul as it is in its inwardness)
which is a self-nullification in [the sense of] existence—this is in the manner of the self-nullification of Atzilus.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains the sequence of "your courtyards," "your house," and "your palace" as corresponding to the service of refining the animal and intellectual souls, the revelation of the Elokis soul within them, and the revelation of the soul above their clothing.

translations.translation: And this is: first "your courtyards," then "your house," and then "your palace,"
first "your courtyards"
(in the plural,
an uncovered courtyard and a covered courtyard)
is the clarification and refinement of the animal soul and the intellectual soul,
for even after their clarification and refinement they are on the level of animals.
Then "your house" is the revelation of the Elokis soul as it is clothed in the intellectual and animal souls,
whose self-nullification is analogous to the self-nullification in Beriah.
And it is called "house,"
for just as a house is a dwelling place for man, as it is written,
"The glory of man is to sit in a house,"
so too the world of Beriah
(the world of the Throne)
is the dwelling place of the Supernal Man,
for the primary dwelling of the Supernal Man in the created beings
is when their self-nullification to Elokus is in a manner that this
(the self-nullification)
is their entire existence.
And then "your palace" is the revelation of the soul that is above its clothing in the animal soul
(including also the inwardness of the level of the soul that is clothed in the animal soul),
whose self-nullification is a self-nullification in [the sense of] existence, like the self-nullification of Atzilus.
And it is called "your palace,"
for the matter of "your palace" is as it is written,
"And Hashem is in His holy palace—be silent before Him, all the earth,"
for in relation to Hashem in His holy palace,
(be silent)
all matter of existence is nullified
(all the earth),
to the point that even the possibility of existence is not applicable.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the verse "Ashrei" is recited before circumcision because the four worlds are the order of Hishtalshelus, while circumcision is above Hishtalshelus, and the service of the four matters in the verse is the preparation for that revelation.

translations.translation: And this is that before the covenant of circumcision we recite the verse "Ashrei temcherem vesarakev,"
for the four worlds of ABY"A are included in the order of Hishtalshelus,
and circumcision is above Hishtalshelus.
And as our sages, of blessed memory, said
on the verse
"For the conductor on the eighth, upon circumcision that was given on the eighth,"
and it is explained in Likkutei Torah
(in the discourse "Lamnatzeiach al Hashminis")
that the fact that Dovid's song was about circumcision being given on the eighth,
is,
for the eighth is the aspect of Adam Kadmon, which is above Atzilus.
And seemingly, one should add,
that circumcision is above not only the four worlds but also above the four letters of the Name Havayah
(the term "What brings into being")
from which the four worlds are brought into being.
And as it is written in Torah Or
on the verse
"Who will go up for us to the heavens,"
whose initial letters are [the letters of] Milah and final letters are [the letters of] Havayah,
for this—that Milah is the initial letters and Havayah is the final letters—is because circumcision is above Havayah.
But in order for the drawing down of the revelation that is above Hishtalshelus to be through circumcision,
the perfection of Hishtalshelus must first be present,
as our sages, of blessed memory, said,
"so that one Shabbos should pass over him,"
for Shabbos is the perfection of Hishtalshelus, and through this it is possible to reach the revelation that is above Hishtalshelus
(circumcision on the eighth).
And it can be said,
that this is what is written,
"Walk before Me and be perfect,"
that first there must be "and be" [which are] the letters of Havayah, and through this one then comes to the aspect of "perfect,"
the revelation through circumcision.
And therefore, before the covenant we recite the verse "Ashrei temcherem vesarakev, yishkon chatzarecha, nisbe'ah b'tuv beisecha, kedosh heichalecha"
[And also on the night before the covenant
(which is the beginning of the preparation for the covenant)
it is customary to study the maamar of the Zohar on this verse],

for the service in the four matters of this verse, which correspond to the four worlds and the four letters of the Name Havayah, is the preparation and vessel for the revelation that is above Hishtalshelus.
